I finished primary school so I can read the names on the fertilizer bags, but I still decide based on what worked last season and what my neighbors do. I own this 1.69 ha so I will buy improved seed and some fertilizer — I got urea and DAP through the agro-dealer last month before the planting rains. I will also spread cattle manure because I want to keep my soil strong since this land belongs to me. My family will do most of the work, but I will hire about twenty days of labor when the weeds are thick because my wife and I cannot hoe all of it alone.
